info.title: Ledgerflow Payments API
info.summary: Idempotent payment initiation and merchant-scoped payment query.
info.description: The implemented `/api/*` routes of `ledgerflow-api`. Every failure is an RFC 9457 problem document with the media type `application/problem+json`. Behavioral invariants are canonical in docs/specifications/payments/, not here; this document is the transport contract only.

servers.description: Local Docker Compose stack, published on loopback only.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Payment initiation and query for the authenticated merchant.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Merchant token revocation on the resource API. The OAuth authorization server itself is not part of this contract.

post.summary: Revoke the presented access token and its refresh token
post.description: Revokes the access token carried by this request and the refresh token issued beside it, in one transaction. Revocation takes effect on the next request, because validation reads `revoked` from the database every time. The merchant authorization session is not touched: it is already invalidated as soon as an authenticated merchant has attempted one authorization. This endpoint is not idempotent: a second call with the same, now revoked, token is answered `401 unauthenticated` like any other endpoint. Clearing the BFF cookies and coordinating the browser's logout belong to the BFF.

204.description: Both tokens are revoked. The response carries no body, and neither token is echoed.

post.description: Commits the idempotency receipt, the stored event and the outbox envelope in one PostgreSQL transaction or none of them. The merchant is resolved from the authenticated user and can never be supplied by the client. Every initiation is arbitrated by the merchant and its payment intent: a retry with the same intent, under the same or a new idempotency key, replays the exact stored response bytes, status and `Location`, even after the intent has expired. No new payment is created once less than 250 ms remain before `Ledgerflow-Intent-Expires-At` by PostgreSQL time, and no write commits after it except a `COMMIT` already executing at that instant, which lands within the residual allowance in ADR 0008.

minimal.summary: A twelve dollar and fifty cent payment

202.description: Accepted. Returned both for a first acceptance and for an identical retry, byte-identical in the latter case.

Location.description: Relative URI reference of the created payment.

409.description: The idempotency key or the payment intent is already bound to a different payment request: the same intent with a different canonical payload, the key bound to another intent, or the key and the intent bound to two different payments. A receipt written before intents existed, matched on the key, conflicts only when the payload differs, and otherwise replays. Nothing new is written.

example.title: Idempotency key or payment intent reused with a different request
example.detail: This idempotency key or payment intent is already bound to a different payment request.

422.description: The request did not satisfy the initiation contract, including a missing or malformed intent header and an expiry too far ahead, or the intent expired, plus the 1 s residual allowance, without creating a payment. Nothing is written.

example.title: Validation failed
example.detail: The request payload did not satisfy the initiation contract.

503.description: Either idempotency arbitration could not finish in time, or the Payments projection gate is closed for a rebuild; the two are distinguished by `code`, never by the status alone. `idempotency_contention` covers exhausted allowlisted transaction retries, an intent refused by its deadline while a concurrent request for it may still commit, and a database session ended at the deadline. `Retry-After` is the whole number of seconds until the outcome settles, at least 1.

value.title: Idempotency contention
value.detail: The request could not be arbitrated in time. Retry.

value.title: Projection rebuilding
value.detail: A projection rebuild is in progress. Retry.

get.description: Reads `payment_details` and, only on a miss, the `payment_idempotency_receipts` fallback, inside one adapter-owned transaction. It never rehydrates the aggregate. A malformed, an unknown and another merchant's payment ID all produce the same `404 payment_not_found`; for one requested ID the unknown and foreign answers are byte-identical, so the endpoint never reveals that a payment exists but belongs to someone else.

parameters.name: paymentId
parameters.description: The payment identifier returned by initiation. The route carries no format constraint: a malformed value is refused by the query adapter with the same answer an unknown one gets.

202.description: The owned idempotency receipt exists but the projection has not landed yet.

404.description: No payment matching this identifier is available to this merchant. `instance` echoes the requested path, which is the only field that differs between a malformed and a well-formed unknown identifier.

example.title: Payment not found
example.detail: No payment matching this identifier is available.

503.description: The Payments projection gate is closed for a rebuild.

example.title: Projection rebuilding
example.detail: A projection rebuild is in progress. Retry.

get.summary: Recover the merchant's recent payment intents
get.description: Lists the authenticated merchant's intent-bearing receipts whose `created_at` is at least `statement_timestamp() - interval '24 hours'` in PostgreSQL time, inclusive, newest first with `created_at` ties ordered by receipt id, at most 20. `truncated` is true when an older qualifying intent exists beyond the 20 returned. Reads `payment_idempotency_receipts` and `payment_details` inside one adapter-owned transaction, joining a projection only under the same merchant. Receipts written without an intent never appear. Takes no parameters.

200.description: The merchant's recent intents. An empty list is still `200`.

503.description: The Payments projection gate is closed for a rebuild.

example.title: Projection rebuilding
example.detail: A projection rebuild is in progress. Retry.

bearerAuth.description: A Passport access token, presented as a bearer JWT. Locally, obtain one with `make demo-token`.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Merchant-scoped request key, bounded in BYTES rather than characters, so a multibyte key can exceed 255 before it reaches 255 characters. Only its SHA-256 digest is ever stored; the raw value never reaches an event, an envelope, a receipt or a log line.

IntentId.name: Ledgerflow-Intent-Id
IntentId.description: Client-generated payment intent, one per payment the merchant means to create. It neither derives from nor reveals the idempotency key, and it is scoped to the merchant. Exactly one value, as a lowercase canonical UUID; any other spelling, including uppercase, braces, surrounding whitespace or a repeated header, is refused.

IntentExpiresAt.name: Ledgerflow-Intent-Expires-At
IntentExpiresAt.description: Absolute expiry the BFF stamps once, at the intent's first claim, and repeats unchanged on every retry. Exactly one value in the `Date.prototype.toISOString()` form, UTC with milliseconds. An expiry more than 32 seconds ahead of PostgreSQL time is refused.

RetryAfterSeconds.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying, at least 1.

Unauthenticated.description: No valid bearer token was presented.

example.title: Unauthenticated
example.detail: This endpoint requires an authenticated merchant user.

amount_minor.description: Minor units. A numeric string is rejected: the contract is a JSON integer.

currency.description: The only settlement currency this API accepts. Case-insensitive on the wire: the request object upper-cases the value before validating it, so "usd" and "Usd" are accepted and normalised to "USD". Anything else is refused with 422 validation_failed.

InitiatePaymentRequest.description: Unknown members are ignored rather than refused; only `merchant_id` is explicitly rejected, because the merchant is resolved from the bearer token.

initiated_at.description: Derived from the event's occurrence time with microsecond fidelity, never from processing time, so a replay reproduces the same value.

status.description: Transport state, not a payment status the domain ever records.

truncated.description: True when a qualifying intent exists beyond the returned list. A truncated response does not show that an absent intent is missing.

created_at.description: The receipt's PostgreSQL creation time, UTC with six fractional digits.

PendingPaymentIntent.description: The payment's projection has not landed yet; `amount_minor` and `currency` are absent, never null.

created_at.description: The receipt's PostgreSQL creation time, UTC with six fractional digits.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem document. Member order below is the wire order. `code` is the stable contract; `type` is derived from it.

type.description: Relative URI reference, resolved against the request URI, of the form `/problems/<code with dashes>`.

detail.description: The client-safe sentence. An exception message is never substituted except for an unmapped internal error with debug enabled.

errors.description: Present only on `validation_failed`. Field name to list of messages.
